credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: Vení is built with open data and open tools. This is what we use and under which license.
credits.osm_body: The map, the routes and the starting point of the directory come from OpenStreetMap, the free map made by people.
credits.osm_import: From OpenStreetMap we only take the name, the type and the location of food places. No phone numbers, emails or social media. Before publishing a place we check it in person, and every listing keeps track of where it came from.
credits.osm_license: The data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
credits.request_body: The part of our database that comes from OpenStreetMap is open too, under the same license (ODbL). If you want it, ask for it and we will send it with the name, type, location and OpenStreetMap identifier.
credits.request_link: Ask for it on the project repository
credits.maplibre: MapLibre GL JS draws the map (3-clause BSD license).
credits.fonts: The Bricolage Grotesque and Figtree typefaces are used under the SIL Open Font License.
legal.draft_body: The Vení team wrote this text based on what the app really does, but a lawyer has not reviewed it yet. It is not legal advice and it may change after that review.

requests.fields_note: All fields are required, except those marked “optional”.
requests.name: Your name
requests.phone_hint: Ten digits, for example 300 123 4567. We will message you here to verify.
requests.privacy_body: We use it only to review this request and contact you about it: it is never published or shared with anyone. Six months after the request is resolved, it is deleted or anonymized.
requests.privacy_policy_link: Read the full personal data policy (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012)
requests.privacy_contact: To see it, correct it or ask us to delete it sooner, write to
requests.privacy_accept: I authorize Vení Roldanillo to process this data to review this request, contact me about it and, if my claim is approved, create my owner account with that name and email.
requests.sent_body: A person on our team reviews it by hand and will message the mobile number you left within about 10 business days. Until then, the listing stays as it is.

claim.intro: If you own or manage this place, let us know and we will verify it so you can update the listing from your panel. You do not need to create an account: if it is approved, we create one for you.
claim.message_hint: Anything that helps us verify, for example how long you have had the business.

removal.intro: If this listing should not be on Vení, tell us why. We review it by hand: until then it stays published.
removal.reason_hint: For example: the place closed, the details belong to another business or we do not want to be listed.
